database_mode.label: Clipboard history database
database_mode.description: Use Clipper's isolated database or the default cliphist database shared with other clipboard tools. In global mode, individual entries can be deleted, but clearing the complete shared history is disabled.

manage_watchers.label: Manage clipboard watchers
manage_watchers.description: Start and supervise the text and image watchers used to populate Clipper's private database.

history_limit.label: History limit
history_limit.description: Maximum number of entries loaded in the panel. In private mode, this also limits the entries retained by Clipper.

enable_notecards.label: Enable notecards
enable_notecards.description: Show quick notes alongside clipboard history and pinned clips.

max_pinned.label: Maximum pinned clips
max_pinned.description: Maximum number of clipboard entries that can be pinned.

auto_paste_delay.label: Paste delay
auto_paste_delay.description: Delay in milliseconds before restoring the previous window and sending the paste shortcut.

history_cards.label: Maximum cards per history page
history_cards.description: Maximum number of clipboard cards per page. Clipper fills the available width and reduces the count automatically on narrower displays.

panel_margin_percent.label: Panel edge margin
panel_margin_percent.description: Margin around the fullscreen Clipper workspace, as a percentage of the active display.

show_panel_background.label: Show panel background
show_panel_background.description: Draw one background behind the entire Clipper workspace. Pinned clips and clipboard history always keep their own surfaces.

card_color.label: History card color
card_color.description: Noctalia theme role or custom color used for clipboard history cards.

pinned_color.label: Pinned card color
pinned_color.description: Noctalia theme role or custom color used for pinned clipboard cards.

notes_color.label: Notecard color
notes_color.description: Noctalia theme role or custom color used for quick notes.

show_close_button.label: Show close button
show_close_button.description: Show a close action in the Clipper panel header.
